hypothesis: On exactly the same complete records and 32 deterministic exact frames used by the frozen PI-DeepONet comparison, the frozen fine-grid method will retain relative L2 below 0.05 overall and in every family on validation and test_id.
purpose: Eliminate frame-selection ambiguity from the PI-DeepONet comparison; this is a reporting analysis and does not tune either method.

frozen_method.spatial_time_scheme: standard eighth-order radius-four LWC84 with fourth-order time correction
frozen_method.output: materialize all 401 registered frames, then score the PI-selected 32 exact indices

no_tuning: The exact record/time panels are read from immutable PI r10 worker reports after both PI split evaluations completed. No result can change the frozen solver.
compute_budget: Four RTX 4090 D workers, approximately two to four minutes per complete split.
